title: kube: Add support for securityContext.seccompProfile.*
body:
### Feature request description

Historically, configuring the seccomp profile in Kubernetes was done using annotations, specifically:
* `seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod`
* `container.seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/<containerName>`

This is the mechanism currently supported by podman play kube (see https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/8130 for more information).

Meanwhile, Kubernetes introduced a dedicated syntax (in v1.19) using the `securityContext.seccompProfile.type` & `securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile` fields (both at the pod level and container level). At the same time, the old annotations were deprecated.

In v1.27, Kubernetes completely removed support for the annotations (see [this entry in the changelog for v1.27](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2023/03/17/upcoming-changes-in-kubernetes-v1-27/#support-for-deprecated-seccomp-annotations)).

Would it be possible to add support for the new fields in podman?

### Suggest potential solution

Proposed transition plan:
* In podman 6.x:
  * Add support for the `securityContext.seccompProfile.type` & `securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile` fields
  * If both the annotations & fields are used, the values in the fields take precedence.
  * Mark the old annotations as deprecated in the docs
* In podman 7.x:
  * Drop support for the old annotations completely

### Have you considered any alternatives?

Using the annotations currently works in podman, but prevents reusing the same YAML file to deploy an app to a Kubernetes cluster (the deployment will work, but the annotations will be silently ignored, which could be a security problem).

### Additional context

More information on the seccomp filtering feature in Kubernetes can be found at https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/security/seccomp/
